metadata.title: Distortions in Judged Spatial Relations in Large Language Models
metadata.description: Benchmark for assessing LLM capability to discern intercardinal directions between geographic locations, evaluating hierarchical spatial bias similar to humans.

benchmark_info.methodology: Each question posed 10 times independently in zero-shot mode

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Canada is generally north of the US, leading to incorrect assumption that Toronto is north of Portland
questions.gps_augmentation: Portland, OR is located at coordinates (45.5202°N, -122.6742°W). Toronto, Canada is located at coordinates (43.6535°N, -79.3839°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Mexico is generally south of the US, potentially influencing directional judgment
questions.gps_augmentation: Tijuana, Mexico is located at coordinates (32.5317°N, -117.0195°W). San Antonio, TX is located at coordinates (29.4246°N, -98.4951°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: State-level orientation may influence judgment
questions.gps_augmentation: Wilmington, NC is located at coordinates (34.2353°N, -77.9487°W). Philadelphia, PA is located at coordinates (39.9527°N, -75.1635°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: State boundaries and west coast orientation may influence judgment
questions.gps_augmentation: San Diego, CA is located at coordinates (32.7174°N, -117.1628°W). Reno, NV is located at coordinates (39.5262°N, -119.8127°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: State-level geographic orientation may influence judgment
questions.gps_augmentation: Memphis, TN is located at coordinates (35.1460°N, -90.0518°W). Milwaukee, WI is located at coordinates (43.0386°N, -87.9091°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - less susceptible to hierarchical categorization
questions.gps_augmentation: Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic is located at coordinates (18.4714°N, -69.8918°W). Miami, FL is located at coordinates (25.7742°N, -80.1936°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - straightforward geographic relationship
questions.gps_augmentation: Minneapolis, MN is located at coordinates (44.9773°N, -93.2655°W). Chicago, IL is located at coordinates (41.8756°N, -87.6244°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - both cities in same state
questions.gps_augmentation: Dallas, TX is located at coordinates (32.7763°N, -96.7969°W). San Antonio, TX is located at coordinates (29.4246°N, -98.4951°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - clear geographic relationship
questions.gps_augmentation: Havana, Cuba is located at coordinates (23.1353°N, -82.3590°W). Philadelphia, PA is located at coordinates (39.9527°N, -75.1635°W).

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - both cities in same state
questions.gps_augmentation: San Antonio, TX is located at coordinates (29.4246°N, -98.4951°W). Houston, TX is located at coordinates (29.7589°N, -95.3677°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Tendency to perceive in-state distances as shorter than cross-state distances. Pittsburgh is ~450km, New Haven is ~250km from Philadelphia.
questions.gps_augmentation: Pittsburgh, PA is located at coordinates (40.4407°N, -80.0026°W). New Haven, CT is located at coordinates (41.3082°N, -72.9251°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Tendency to perceive in-state distances as shorter than cross-state distances
questions.gps_augmentation: Houston, TX is located at coordinates (29.7589°N, -95.3677°W). Oklahoma City, OK is located at coordinates (35.4730°N, -97.5171°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - all cities in same state
questions.gps_augmentation: Houston, TX is located at coordinates (29.7589°N, -95.3677°W). Austin, TX is located at coordinates (30.2711°N, -97.7437°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - all cities in same state, Johnstown is ~390km from Philadelphia
questions.gps_augmentation: Johnstown, PA is located at coordinates (40.3267°N, -78.9220°W). Pittsburgh, PA is located at coordinates (40.4407°N, -80.0026°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: West coast curvature - San Diego is commonly assumed to be furthest west due to being on the coast
questions.gps_augmentation: San Diego, CA is located at coordinates (32.7174°N, -117.1628°W). Fresno, CA is located at coordinates (36.7394°N, -119.7848°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: East coast curvature simplification leads to errors
questions.gps_augmentation: Wilmington, NC is located at coordinates (34.2353°N, -77.9487°W). Jacksonville, NC is located at coordinates (34.7510°N, -77.4310°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - both coastal cities, common geographical feature forces more precise comparisons
questions.gps_augmentation: Wilmington, NC is located at coordinates (34.2353°N, -77.9487°W). Morehead City, NC is located at coordinates (34.7229°N, -76.7260°W).

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - well-known California cities
questions.gps_augmentation: Los Angeles, CA is located at coordinates (34.0537°N, -118.2428°W). San Francisco, CA is located at coordinates (37.7879°N, -122.4075°W).

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Common misconception that North America and Europe align on the same east-west axis, while Europe is predominantly north of the United States
questions.gps_augmentation: Monaco is located at coordinates (43.7323°N, 7.4277°W). Chicago, IL is located at coordinates (41.8756°N, -87.6244°W).

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Europe-North America alignment misconception
questions.gps_augmentation: Rome, Italy is located at coordinates (41.8933°N, 12.4829°W). Philadelphia, PA is located at coordinates (39.9527°N, -75.1635°W).

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - Lisbon is indeed south of New York City, straightforward relationship
questions.gps_augmentation: Lisbon, Portugal is located at coordinates (38.7078°N, -9.1366°W). New York City, NY is located at coordinates (40.7127°N, -74.0060°W).

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - clear geographic relationship
questions.gps_augmentation: Madrid, Spain is located at coordinates (40.4168°N, -3.7035°W). Boston, MA is located at coordinates (42.3588°N, -71.0578°W).
